newsitem.title: USA: B.V.R. gets $40 mln contract for system.
newsitem.headline: B.V.R. gets $40 mln contract for system.

text.p: B.V.R. Technologies Ltd Monday said it won a contract for the supply of a large scale, leading edge technology standard simulation system for an unidentified foreign customer army.

This award includes development and supply of a simulation "farm" including multiple networked simulation stations capable of serving interchangeable vehicle type "capsules." The value of the contract is $40 million, with options for $11 million in additional purchases. Deliveries will commence in two years, with system final deliveries scheduled in three years' time (or the first quarter of year 2000).
B.V.R. said it competed for this contract with major companies from the U.S. and France.

B.V.R. said it has diversified its simulation expertise in recent years from aircraft simulators to UAV (Unmanned Airborne Vehicle) simulators, naval simulators (operational with one customer since 1995, with additional systems under development) and now to ground forces simulation systems.
B.V.R. Technologies Ltd is engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of advanced training and simulation systems for land, sea and air applications.
